canDoYue: 你識話進度跟得上定落後、星期五之前跟進，同埋寫低行動項。
canDoEn: Say the work is on track or behind schedule, follow up by Friday, and name an action item.

dialogue.speaker: sora
dialogue.text: Our design work is fully on track this month, and the morning meeting can stay short today.
dialogue.glossYue: 我哋設計呢個月完全跟得上進度，今朝個會可以短啲。
dialogue.say: Our design work is fully on track this month, and the morning meeting can stay short today.

dialogue.speaker: niles
dialogue.text: Which part of the monthly plan is behind schedule now, and who owns that open piece of work?
dialogue.glossYue: 月計劃邊一部分而家落後，嗰部分邊個負責？
dialogue.say: Which part of the monthly plan is behind schedule now, and who owns that open piece of work?

dialogue.speaker: sora
dialogue.text: The sample run is behind schedule, so I will follow up with the client myself this afternoon.
dialogue.glossYue: 樣辦落後咗，我下晝自己同客戶跟進。
dialogue.say: The sample run is behind schedule, so I will follow up with the client myself this afternoon.

dialogue.speaker: niles
dialogue.text: Can you follow up by Friday and send me a short written note after you call them back?
dialogue.glossYue: 你可唔可以星期五之前跟進，打完電話寫張短筆記畀我？
dialogue.say: Can you follow up by Friday and send me a short written note after you call them back?

dialogue.speaker: sora
dialogue.text: I will follow up by Friday, and I will send the written note out during that same quiet afternoon.
dialogue.glossYue: 我會星期五之前跟進，同一個安靜下晝將筆記寄出。
dialogue.say: I will follow up by Friday, and I will send the written note out during that same quiet afternoon.

dialogue.speaker: niles
dialogue.text: Are there any open questions before we write down each action item for the whole team?
dialogue.glossYue: 寫低每個行動項之前，仲有冇未解決嘅問題？
dialogue.say: Are there any open questions before we write down each action item for the whole team?

dialogue.speaker: sora
dialogue.text: The action item is for me to call the client on Friday morning before we break.
dialogue.glossYue: 行動項係我星期五朝早打電話畀客戶，散會之前。
dialogue.say: The action item is for me to call the client on Friday morning before we break.

dialogue.speaker: niles
dialogue.text: Please send that written action item straight after the meeting so the whole plan stays clear.
dialogue.glossYue: 會後請將書面行動項寄出，成個計劃先清晰。
dialogue.say: Please send that written action item straight after the meeting so the whole plan stays clear.
